name: Can I stay in my home during a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my home during a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, yes, you can remain in your home during a kitchen remodel. However, expect significant disruption, noise, and dust. Your kitchen will be a construction zone, and you may be without running water, cooking facilities, or access to certain areas for periods. Many homeowners opt to set up a temporary kitchen elsewhere in the house. Your contractor can provide a realistic overview of the daily impact.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can typically stay home during a kitchen remodel, but expect noise, dust, and limited access to kitchen facilities. A temporary kitchen setup may be helpful.
